references.text: Ezekiel 36:26-27 describes God's action of giving a new heart and a new spirit, which is the inner transformation that occurs when the Father draws a person to the Son.
In John 12:32, Jesus uses the same Greek verb (helkyō) to describe how He will "draw" all people to Himself, which is a direct parallel to the Father's action in 6:44.
John 17:6 confirms that the disciples belonged to the Father and were given to the Son, illustrating the preceding action where the Father draws and gives people to the Son.
Romans 8:29-30 describes God's eternal plan in which He foreknew, called, and justified, reflecting the essential role the Father plays in drawing people to the Son.
